title: Task Completion Logic & Dependencies
notes: Full Track B scoping complete: TRACK_DECISION.md, design/README.md, planning/README.md, testing/README.md created. Ready for implementation phase. Three core features: (1) Dependency enforcement - block completion if subtasks incomplete, (2) Auto-completion - auto-complete parent when last subtask done, (3) Manual override - allow completion for tasks with no subtasks. 18 implementation tasks identified with 14 hour estimate. Test strategy covers unit, integration, E2E, and frontend tests.
